data.name: Dilemma Dungeon
data.detailed_description:
Dilemma Dungeon is a 4-player co-op top-down roguelike dungeon exploration game.

To overcome the cursed dungeon, players must work together, but every choice comes at a cost.

At every moment of combat and growth, players face choices: will you become stronger yourself, or sacrifice for your allies? You may raise your own stats significantly at the cost of lowering a teammate’s, or make someone else stronger while weakening yourself.

The game consists of three stages, and with ever-changing room layouts, monsters, and events, each run is a brand new challenge.

Players complete their own builds by combining different classes, skills, and equipment items, and must break the curse to reach the end of the dungeon.

In this dungeon, where cooperation and betrayal, sacrifice and greed intertwine—can you maintain trust with your teammates until the very end?
